statement: Prospective enterprise and SMB clients cannot quickly understand what the Logia Initiative does or credibly evaluate its agentic-AI software delivery capability, so qualified buyers leave without making contact and the team has no reliable inbound channel to capture and qualify leads.
impact: Without a compelling, trustworthy web presence and a working inquiry channel, high-intent visitors (GRC audit, custom development, and architecture-consulting buyers) drop off before converting, forcing the team to rely on outbound effort and losing pipeline that a differentiated, conversion-focused site would capture.
